title: Cross-project data disclosure
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: RLS before retrieval; current membership checked before execution and delivery; adversarial isolation tests

title: WhatsApp use-case restriction
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Policy review and independent web portal; never disguise generic AI service

title: Unverified airbag/fitment claim
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Hard stop on listing until exact SKU evidence and review

title: Misleading property geometry
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Zero material geometry defects gate; capture/hybrid fallback

title: Live execution or overstated paper performance
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: No live adapter or credentials; paper limitations disclosed

title: No demand or copied marketplace content
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Demand gate, rights ledger, originality and disclosure checks

title: Run duplication and cost growth
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Unique action keys, budget reservation, bounded retries, reconciliation

title: Unrecoverable memory or unlicensed sharing
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Database and object backups, restore drill, scope and rights lineage

title: Liquidity/custody/regulatory exposure
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Monitor only until independent route/economics/perimeter gates

title: Unsupported wall-printer purchase or supplier lock-in
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Require comparable written quotes, landed-cost evidence, warranty/support terms, sample output and a paid-demand pilot before purchase or lease

title: Property authority, client-money or listing compliance failure
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Use written property authority, disclose the operating model, avoid receiving guest funds until reviewed and verify redress, client-money, insurance and local-property obligations

title: Clinical service proceeds without registered provider or suitable premises
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Named clinical lead, confirmed professional scope, CQC and indemnity review, premises readiness and approved patient pathway before marketing or treatment

title: Unsafe, non-compliant or unprofitable online product
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Demand-first selection, supplier and product-safety dossier, landed contribution model, returns test and one-product capped pilot before scale

title: Unlawful outreach, finance misstatement or cross-dealer data disclosure
scoring_basis: proposed 1-5 qualitative assessment; not actuarial probability
mitigation: Dealer-authorized data only, deterministic tenant isolation, approved communication templates, human approval before outbound messages and FCA/PECR review before finance or marketing use
